terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.s1Body: By using Aldlalz you agree to these terms. If you do not agree, do not use the platform.
terms.s2Body: You are responsible for the accuracy of your property listings. Aldlalz may review, approve, or remove content that violates these terms or applicable Kuwait law.
terms.s3Body: You must provide accurate registration information and keep your credentials secure. You are responsible for activity under your account.
terms.s4Body: Paid plans and listing limits apply as described on the Packages page. Fees are subject to change with notice.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.s1Body: We collect account information (email, name, phone), listing content, and usage data necessary to operate the marketplace.
privacy.s2Body: Data is used to provide the service, enable buyer–seller contact, process subscriptions, and improve the platform.
privacy.s3Body: Your phone number and listing details are shown to buyers on approved listings. We do not sell personal data to third parties.
privacy.s4Body: We apply industry-standard measures to protect your data. No method of transmission over the internet is 100% secure.
privacy.s5Body: You may update your profile or request account deletion by contacting info@aldlalz.com
